review.instructions: docs/specification.md is the binding contract, and its Normative Clarifications and Resolved by review sections are decisions. The ADRs in docs/adr are the rationale of record, and docs/MAESTRO_DIVERGENCES.md lists every deliberate difference from Maestro. Each PR body lists what it intentionally does not do. A decision documented in the spec, an ADR or the divergences file is not a defect; drift between the code and those documents is.
